context: Local OAuth credential-artifact reading is copy-pasted across three adapters: ClaudeOAuthAuth (claude.py:146-278), CodexOAuthAuth (codex.py:152-310, docstring says 'Mirrors ClaudeOAuthAuth'), and KimiOAuthAuth (kimi.py:118-230). _read_keychain is byte-identical in claude.py and codex.py; _is_expired is duplicated (claude.py:280, codex.py:350); _load_artifact differs only in which JSON key is extracted. The never-fall-back-to-env security invariant and never-log-material are enforced three times instead of once; the next OAuth provider copies it by hand. The ProviderAdapter Protocol (ADR 0002 11.3) and the ProviderAuth protocol (auth.py) are frozen surfaces this change must not alter.
root_causes: the deep module behind the ProviderAuth seam was never extracted; each adapter copied the pattern instead of importing it
no contract test pins the shared auth invariants (env fallback, expiry, redaction) across adapters, so copies drift silently
evidence: claude.py and codex.py contain byte-identical _read_keychain; _is_expired duplicated at claude.py:280 and codex.py:350
codex.py:152 docstring literally states it mirrors ClaudeOAuthAuth
auth.py holds only the 139-line protocol; zero shared implementation behind it
solutions: one LocalOAuthArtifactAuth module (params: keychain_service, credentials_path, artifact_key extractor, expiry predicate) under src/reverso/protocols/adapters/; claude and codex contribute ~3 lines each; kimi reuses the artifact reader and keeps its refresh logic

a contract test asserting the shared invariants once for all three adapters: no env fallback (token from env alone must NOT authenticate), keychain-first-then-file order, expiry enforced, no token material in repr/log surfaces
per-adapter parameter tests keep coverage of provider-specific behavior (kimi refresh flow)
acceptance_criteria: one shared LocalOAuthArtifactAuth implementation; claude/codex/kimi adapters contain no private _read_keychain/_is_expired copies

contract test proves the never-env-fallback invariant once for the shared artifact readers (claude/codex); kimi retains its pre-existing, documented, test-pinned KIMI_BEARER_TOKEN env fallback (present on main before this goal; removal or ratification is a separate follow-up goal)
ProviderAdapter Protocol and ProviderAuth protocol unchanged (frozen surfaces)
files are moved to Archive/, never deleted, if any file removal is needed (repo rule)
